title: Gameplay placement
description: Free region of osu!'s layout the readout sits in during play. auto: top-right under score/accuracy (below the mod icons) for osu!, catch and mania; below the lane on the right for taiko. Left zones keep clear of the HP bar and combo; for taiko, bottom zones sit just below the lane.

title: Song select placement
description: Where the accuracy ladder sits in song select: the top or bottom of the centre column between the local leaderboard and the beatmap carousel (osu!stable layout), or the gameplay placement.

title: Nudge right / px
description: Moves the readout horizontally (negative = left) for skins that place things differently. Applies in every state.

title: Nudge down / px
description: Moves the readout vertically (negative = up). Applies in every state.

title: Scale
description: Size multiplier, 0.5–2. The readout also shrinks on its own when its region is narrower (e.g. left of a mania stage).

title: Backing
description: none: text floats on the game with a contrast shadow. scrim: a soft dark fade behind it, for bright backgrounds. panel: the 18-LAB graphite panel.

title: Accent colour
description: map: highlights (pp fill, live dot, labels) take the tonal colour of the current map's background; falls back to 18-LAB amber when the map has none. 18-lab: always amber.

title: Show if-FC pp
description: During play, what the score would be worth as a full combo at the current accuracy, as a readout and an FC tick on the rail.

title: Show max achievable pp
description: During play, the most this attempt can still reach if every remaining object is hit perfectly; the hatched band on the rail runs from current pp to it.

title: Show pp breakdown
description: During play, current pp split into its non-zero components: aim, speed, accuracy and flashlight for osu!; difficulty and accuracy for taiko, catch and mania.

title: Show accuracy ladder in song select
description: pp at 95, 97, 98, 99 and 100% accuracy for the selected map and mods — osu! does not show pp in song select. Off: nothing is shown in song select.

title: Decimal places
description: Decimal places on pp readouts. The ladder, breakdown and rail scale always show whole pp.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: Shows the 18—LAB tag above the readout.
